description: This PHP class 'DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor' handles duplication of investment actions with customizable limits and rules within the Goteo crowdfunding platform, including reward matching and investment amount calculations.

classes.name: DuplicateInvestMatcherProcessor
classes.description: Handles duplication of investments with limits and reward matching logic

methods.name: getDesc
methods.description: Returns description of the matcher rules

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Calculates the amount to be invested, considering rewards

methods.name: getRegularAmount
methods.description: Calculates standard investment amount based on limits and available funds
